# VitePress Sidebar

> VitePress Sidebar is a VitePress plugin that automatically generates the sidebar menu of a documentation site from the folder and Markdown file structure, with a single configuration. It scans a document root path hierarchically, then filters, sorts, and formats the entries into the `themeConfig.sidebar` structure that VitePress expects.

Key facts:

- Package: `vitepress-sidebar` (npm), MIT licensed, authored by CDGet (jooy2).
- Written in ESM with TypeScript type definitions. Node.js 20 or higher is required (Node.js 22+ recommended). CommonJS projects need the ESM workaround described in the troubleshooting page.
- Install as a dev dependency: `npm i -D vitepress-sidebar` (also available via yarn/pnpm).
- Two entry points: `withSidebar(vitePressOptions, sidebarOptions)` used at the `defineConfig` level (recommended, supports hot reload), and `generateSidebar(sidebarOptions)` used at the `themeConfig.sidebar` level.
- Supports multiple sidebars (pass an array of option objects), frontmatter-driven titles/order/exclusion, internationalization, and fine-grained menu formatting.
- Options can also be declared in a `sidebar.config.json` file placed in any folder. Such a file configures the folder it lives in and every subfolder below it, and takes priority over the options passed as an argument.
- The `$folder` key of a `sidebar.config.json` describes the folder itself (`order`, `text`, `link`) instead of its contents, and is not inherited by subfolders. It lets a folder be ordered, named and linked without an `index.md`, and keeps the position of a folder independent of the position of its `index.md` inside it.

Minimal usage in `.vitepress/config.js`:

```javascript
import { defineConfig } from 'vitepress';
import { withSidebar } from 'vitepress-sidebar';

const vitePressOptions = {
  title: 'My Docs',
  themeConfig: {}
};

const vitePressSidebarOptions = {
  documentRootPath: '/docs',
  collapsed: false,
  capitalizeFirst: true,
  useTitleFromFileHeading: true
};

export default defineConfig(withSidebar(vitePressOptions, vitePressSidebarOptions));
```

Option categories (see the Options page for every option and example):

- Resolving paths: `documentRootPath`, `scanStartPath`, `resolvePath`, `basePath`, `followSymlinks`
- Grouping: `collapsed`, `collapseDepth`, `collapseFromLevel`, `rootGroupText`, `rootGroupLink`, `rootGroupCollapsed`
- Getting menu title: `useTitleFromFileHeading`, `useTitleFromFrontmatter`, `useFolderTitleFromIndexFile`, `frontmatterTitleFieldName`, `dynamicRouteTitleParam`
- Getting menu link: `useFolderLinkFromSameNameSubFile`, `useFolderLinkFromIndexFile`, `folderLinkNotIncludesFileName`
- Include / exclude: `excludeByGlobPattern`, `excludeFilesByFrontmatterFieldName`, `excludeByFolderDepth`, `includeDotFiles`, `includeEmptyFolder`, `includeRootIndexFile`, `includeFolderIndexFile`, `includeDynamicRoutes`
- Styling menu title: `hyphenToSpace`, `underscoreToSpace`, `capitalizeFirst`, `capitalizeEachWords`, `keepMarkdownSyntaxFromTitle`, `removePrefixAfterOrdering`, `prefixSeparator`
- Sorting: `manualSortFileNameByPriority`, `sortFolderTo`, `sortMenusByName`, `sortMenusByFileDatePrefix`, `sortMenusByFrontmatterOrder`, `frontmatterOrderDefaultValue`, `sortMenusByFileCreateDate`, `sortMenusByFileModifyDate`, `sortMenusByFrontmatterDate`, `sortMenusOrderByDescending`, `sortMenusOrderNumericallyFromTitle`, `sortMenusOrderNumericallyFromLink`, `sortMenusByCustomFunction`
- Misc: `debugPrint`

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/introduction): What VitePress Sidebar is, its features, and real-world usage.
- [Getting Started](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/guide/getting-started): Installation, how the scanner works, `withSidebar` vs `generateSidebar`, `documentRootPath` setup, and a full commented option template.
- [Sidebar Options](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/guide/options): Reference for every option with defaults, types, and before/after examples.

## Advanced usage

- [Configuration file](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/advanced-usage/configuration-file): Put a `sidebar.config.json` in any folder to configure that folder and everything below it, describe the folder itself with `$folder`, override the options passed as an argument, and omit `documentRootPath`.
- [Multiple Sidebars How-to](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/advanced-usage/multiple-sidebars-how-to): Show a different sidebar per URI path by passing an array of option objects with `documentRootPath`, `scanStartPath`, `resolvePath`, and `basePath`.
- [Internationalization](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/advanced-usage/internationalization): Generate a sidebar per language directory, with VitePress `locales` and the `vitepress-i18n` plugin.
- [Multi-level sidebar with indents](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/advanced-usage/multi-level-sidebar-with-indents): Custom CSS to indent nested sidebar levels correctly in the default theme.

## Troubleshooting

- [CommonJS: ERR_REQUIRE_ESM](https://vitepress-sidebar.cdget.com/troubleshooting/err-require-esm): Fixes for CJS projects — rename the config to `.mjs`, or add `"type": "module"` to `package.json`.
